_readme: Editable SEO config for gsc-monitor.py. Keys with underscore prefix are notes and ignored by the script. Priority keywords are grouped by tier so the weekly report can show winnable-first, then progressively harder targets.

priority_keywords._tier_1_brand: High-win, low-effort. Should already rank top 3 for brand searches. If not, something is broken.
priority_keywords._tier_2_signature: Signature niche (traditional oven builder). Low search volume but high intent — customer already knows what they want. Target: top 10 in 3-6 months. Keywords marked '_vs_aurora' are the specific short-term battleground vs auroraovens.com (Bali-based pizza-oven prefab specialist).
priority_keywords._tier_3_service: Kitchen contractor services — mid-competition, target: top 20 in 6-12 months.
priority_keywords._tier_4_generic: High-volume generic keywords. Long game (12+ months). Track for trend but don't obsess over position.

competitors_to_watch._note: Update quarterly. Head-to-head compare via manual search in incognito for the priority keywords.
competitors_to_watch._primary_short_term_target: auroraovens.com — Bali-based Italian-heritage pizza-oven prefab specialist. Weakness: pizza-only (no mandi/tannur/kamado), Bali-based (no Jakarta geo advantage), prefab-only (no custom sizes). Target: beat them in Jakarta-local pizza oven queries AND dominate the niche categories they don't compete in.

_aurora_ovens_intel.unique_offer: Free test drive at Bali showroom — customer bakes their own pizza
keywords_they_are_WEAK_at: oven pizza tradisional custom (they only prefab)
oven pizza mozaik emas (they don't offer specialty finishes)
